newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ACQUISITION NEWS PUSH ZALAKERAMIA TO HIGHS.
newsitem.headline: ACQUISITION NEWS PUSH ZALAKERAMIA TO HIGHS.

text.p: The shares in Hungarian tile maker Zalakeramia Rt rose to new record territories in early trading on Tuesday bolstered by acquisition news, traders said.

"The announcement of the acquisition plans definitely explain the current price increase," a trader said. "Should further information be released on the deals Zalakeramia share price may rise further."
Zalakeramia shares opened at 8,200 forints, above Monday's close of 8,150 forints and soared to a new record of 8,500 forints. At 1116 GMT Zalakeramia stocks traded at 8,400.
"Zalakeramia is a typical example of continuous 'buy' recommendations which said it was poised to long-term growth and is well managed," the trader said.
On Monday Zalakeramia said it would hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on February 12 to discuss issues related to its planned new acquisitions.

The tile maker said three companies were of serious interest and to fund these acquisitions the board was seeking shareholders' approval for the issue of between 0.9 million and 1.2 million new ordinary shares, to be offered privately to Hungarian and foreign institutional investors.
It also said it would use a bridging loan to finance the deals, which will be made through a new Austrian company, Eurokeramika AG, which is to be 95 percent owned by Zalakeramia.
